blocks.text: MANILA – The Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP) successfully monitored in real time the Chinese aircraft carrier Liaoning and its escort vessels as they entered Philippine waters during a military exercise last October. Retired Navy reservist, Rear Admiral Roy Vincent Trinidad, AFP spokesperson for the West Philippine Sea (WPS), in a briefing in Camp Aguinaldo in Quezon City on Tuesday, said the public has nothing to worry about the entry of the carrier and its escorts since it was a regular exercise of the People’s Liberation Army Navy (PLAN).
